camps.description: Greenwich Council Cub Scout day camp on the 238-acre Ernest Thompson Seton Scout Reservation, open to Scouts and non-Scouts; program areas include shooting sports, swimming pool, climbing tower, boating, nature, and creek exploration. Specific 2026 weekly session dates not cleanly published (2025 weekly fee was $620 early / $670 regular).
camps.name: Camp Seton (Ernest Thompson Seton Scout Reservation)
